mistake_reason: At step 9, WebSurfer asserted it would "open the attached Excel" and claimed to read local file captions, which is outside its defined role (web browsing only) and infringes FileSurfer’s responsibility. This role violation (FM-1.2) introduced a fabricated detail that Table 5 mapped to reference 7, leading the team to adopt an incorrect mapping and produce the wrong final answer.
